mergedParams.userDescription: Gentle easing and anticipation. internal effects for text, video, images

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'anticipate-fade' that combines gentle anticipation movement with opacity transitions. The effect should start with a subtle backward ease (like pulling back a slingshot) at 10% scale reduction and 0 opacity, then smoothly accelerate forward past the target position to 105% scale with full opacity, before settling at 100% scale. Use cubic-bezier easing with anticipation curve (0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55). Accept parameters for duration (default 800ms), overshoot amount (default 0.05), and targetIds array. The effect should work universally for text, images, and video atoms by targeting their IDs.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect type using AnimationRange[]. Effect structure: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 800, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'scale', val: [0.9, 1.05, 1], prog: [0, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 1, 1], prog: [0, 0.4, 1] }] }. Easing: cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55). Input schema: z.object({ duration: z.number().optional(), overshoot: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: [effectData] }

prompts.prompt: Build a 'soft-breathe' internal effect preset that creates a gentle breathing rhythm for any element. The effect should scale from 100% to 102% and back in a sine wave pattern, with synchronized opacity pulsing from 0.95 to 1. Include a subtle blur that goes from 0 to 0.5px at the peak of each breath. Accept parameters for breathDuration (default 3000ms), breathIntensity (0-1, default 0.02 for 2% scale), and blurEnabled (boolean). The timing should feel organic and meditative, perfect for background elements or ambient text.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with looping animation. Effect structure: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.breathDuration || 3000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, loop: true, ranges: [{ key: 'scale', val: [1, 1 + (params.breathIntensity || 0.02), 1], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0.95, 1, 0.95], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }, { key: 'blur', val: params.blurEnabled ? [0, 0.5, 0] : [0, 0, 0], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }] }. Easing: ease-in-out. Input schema: z.object({ breathDuration: z.number().optional(), breathIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(), blurEnabled: z.boolean().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) })

prompts.prompt: Design a 'gentle-drift' internal effect preset that creates subtle floating movement with easing. Elements should drift upward by 20px while rotating slightly (3 degrees) with a very soft ease-out curve. Include a gentle opacity fade from 0.8 to 1 during the first 30% of the animation. Accept parameters for driftDistance (default -20 for upward), rotationAmount (default 3), startOpacity (default 0.8), and duration (default 2000ms). Perfect for creating atmospheric, dreamy effects on text overlays or image elements.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect using transform and opacity. Effect structure: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 2000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'translateY', val: [0, params.driftDistance || -20], prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'rotate', val: [0, params.rotationAmount || 3], prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [params.startOpacity || 0.8, 1, 1], prog: [0, 0.3, 1] }] }. Easing: ease-out. Input schema: z.object({ driftDistance: z.number().optional(), rotationAmount: z.number().optional(), startOpacity: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(), duration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) })

prompts.prompt: Create an 'ease-reveal' internal effect preset that unveils content with sophisticated masking-like behavior using scale and opacity. Start with scaleY at 0 (collapsed) and opacity 0, then expand vertically with a custom spring easing while opacity fades in with a different timing. Add a subtle brightness boost (1.2) during the reveal that settles back to 1. Accept parameters for revealDirection ('vertical' or 'horizontal'), springTension (default 180), springFriction (default 12), and brightnessPeak (default 1.2). This creates a refined reveal perfect for text blocks or media elements.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with spring easing. Effect structure: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, easing: 'spring', springConfig: { tension: params.springTension || 180, friction: params.springFriction || 12 }, ranges: [{ key: params.revealDirection === 'horizontal' ? 'scaleX' : 'scaleY', val: [0, 1], prog: [0, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 1], prog: [0, 0.6] }, { key: 'brightness', val: [1, params.brightnessPeak || 1.2, 1], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }] }. Input schema: z.object({ revealDirection: z.enum(['vertical', 'horizontal']).optional(), springTension: z.number().optional(), springFriction: z.number().optional(), brightnessPeak: z.number().optional(), duration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) })

prompts.prompt: Build a 'micro-shake' waveform effect preset that adds subtle, bass-reactive trembling to elements. The shake should respond to low frequencies (20-250Hz) with micro movements of 1-3 pixels, creating a gentle vibration that adds life without being distracting. Include rotation wobble (±1 degree) synchronized with the bass hits. Accept parameters for sensitivity (0-1, default 0.3), maxShake (default 3px), and frequencyRange (default [20, 250]). Perfect for adding subtle energy to static text or images during music sequences.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Waveform audio-reactive effect. Effect structure: { type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 5000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, waveformType: 'shake', props: { audio: 'bass', sensitivity: params.sensitivity || 0.3, threshold: 0.2, maxShake: params.maxShake || 3, shakeDirection: 'both', includeRotation: true, maxRotation: 1, frequencyRange: params.frequencyRange || [20, 250] } }. Input schema: z.object({ sensitivity: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(), maxShake: z.number().optional(), frequencyRange: z.tuple([z.number(), z.number()]).optional(), duration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Design a 'soft-glow-pulse' internal effect preset that creates a gentle glowing effect using filter combinations. Apply a subtle drop-shadow that pulses from transparent to a soft colored glow (0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.5)) synchronized with a slight scale pulse (100% to 101%). Include brightness adjustment from 1 to 1.1. Accept parameters for glowColor (default white), glowRadius (default 20px), pulseIntensity (default 0.01), and pulseDuration (default 1500ms). Ideal for highlighting important text or creating ambient lighting effects on images.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect with filter animations. Effect structure: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.pulseDuration || 1500, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, loop: true, ranges: [{ key: 'filter', val: [`drop-shadow(0 0 0px transparent)`, `drop-shadow(0 0 ${params.glowRadius || 20}px ${params.glowColor || 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'})`, `drop-shadow(0 0 0px transparent)`], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }, { key: 'scale', val: [1, 1 + (params.pulseIntensity || 0.01), 1], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }, { key: 'brightness', val: [1, 1.1, 1], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }] }. Easing: ease-in-out. Input schema: z.object({ glowColor: z.string().optional(), glowRadius: z.string().optional(), pulseIntensity: z.number().optional(), pulseDuration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) })

prompts.prompt: Create an 'anticipate-slide' combined effect preset that merges horizontal sliding with anticipation easing. Elements pull back 10% in the opposite direction before sliding to their final position with a gentle overshoot. Combine this with a complementary opacity curve that starts at 0, reaches 0.5 during the pullback, then smoothly animates to 1. Accept parameters for slideDistance (default 100px), pullbackRatio (default 0.1), overshootRatio (default 0.05), and slideDirection ('left', 'right', 'up', 'down'). This creates smooth, professional transitions for any content type.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Combined generic effects array. Effect structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1200, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)', ranges: [{ key: params.slideDirection === 'up' || params.slideDirection === 'down' ? 'translateY' : 'translateX', val: [0, -(params.slideDistance * params.pullbackRatio), params.slideDistance * (1 + params.overshootRatio), params.slideDistance], prog: [0, 0.2, 0.8, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.5, 1, 1], prog: [0, 0.2, 0.6, 1] }] }] }. Input schema: z.object({ slideDistance: z.number().optional(), pullbackRatio: z.number().optional(), overshootRatio: z.number().optional(), slideDirection: z.enum(['left', 'right', 'up', 'down']).optional(), duration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) })

prompts.prompt: Build a 'gentle-morph' internal effect preset that smoothly transforms text properties with sophisticated easing. Animate letterSpacing from tight (-0.05em) to normal (0) to slightly loose (0.02em), while fontSize scales from 95% to 100% to 102% and settles at 100%. Add a subtle color shift using CSS filters (hue-rotate from -5deg to 5deg). Accept parameters for morphIntensity (0-1), textExpansion (boolean), and colorShift (boolean). Perfect for creating elegant text transitions in title sequences or emphasis effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Generic effect for text properties. Effect structure: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1500, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'letterSpacing', val: ['-0.05em', '0em', '0.02em', '0em'], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'fontSize', val: ['95%', '100%', '102%', '100%'], prog: [0, 0.4, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'filter', val: params.colorShift ? ['hue-rotate(-5deg)', 'hue-rotate(5deg)', 'hue-rotate(0deg)'] : ['none', 'none', 'none'], prog: [0, 0.6, 1] }] }. Easing: ease-in-out. Input schema: z.object({ morphIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(), textExpansion: z.boolean().optional(), colorShift: z.boolean().optional(), duration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) })

prompts.prompt: Design an 'ambient-float' waveform effect preset that creates gentle, music-reactive floating movement. Elements should respond to mid-range frequencies (250-2000Hz) with subtle vertical translation (±10px) and slight rotation (±2deg), creating an underwater-like floating effect. The movement should lag slightly behind the audio for a more organic feel. Accept parameters for floatRange (default 10px), rotationRange (default 2deg), frequencyBand ('bass', 'mid', 'treble'), and lagAmount (0-1, default 0.3). Ideal for creating atmospheric backgrounds or dreamy text overlays.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Waveform audio-reactive effect with translate. Effect structure: { type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 10000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, waveformType: 'translate', props: { audio: params.frequencyBand || 'mid', sensitivity: 0.4, threshold: 0.15, maxTranslateY: params.floatRange || 10, maxTranslateX: params.floatRange * 0.5 || 5, includeRotation: true, maxRotation: params.rotationRange || 2, lagAmount: params.lagAmount || 0.3, frequencyRange: params.frequencyBand === 'bass' ? [20, 250] : params.frequencyBand === 'treble' ? [2000, 20000] : [250, 2000] } }. Input schema: z.object({ floatRange: z.number().optional(), rotationRange: z.number().optional(), frequencyBand: z.enum(['bass', 'mid', 'treble']).optional(), lagAmount: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(), duration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) })

prompts.prompt: Create a 'soft-dissolve' internal effect preset that combines multiple gentle transitions for a sophisticated dissolve effect. Start with blur at 3px, scale at 0.95, and opacity at 0. Gradually reduce blur to 0, scale up to 1.02 then settle at 1, while opacity eases to 1. Add a subtle brightness boost that peaks at 1.15 midway through. Include optional grain texture overlay that fades out as the element becomes clear. Accept parameters for initialBlur (default 3px), scaleRange (default [0.95, 1.02, 1]), brightnessBoost (default 1.15), and includeGrain (boolean). Perfect for cinematic transitions between scenes or revealing hero content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Combined generic effects with multiple properties. Effect structure: { type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1800, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, easing: 'ease-out', ranges: [{ key: 'blur', val: [params.initialBlur || 3, 1, 0], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }, { key: 'scale', val: params.scaleRange || [0.95, 1.02, 1], prog: [0, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.8, 1], prog: [0, 0.4, 0.8] }, { key: 'brightness', val: [1, params.brightnessBoost || 1.15, 1], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }, { key: 'filter', val: params.includeGrain ? ['contrast(1.1) grayscale(0.1)', 'contrast(1.05) grayscale(0.05)', 'contrast(1) grayscale(0)'] : ['none', 'none', 'none'], prog: [0, 0.5, 1] }] }. Input schema: z.object({ initialBlur: z.number().optional(), scaleRange: z.array(z.number()).length(3).optional(), brightnessBoost: z.number().optional(), includeGrain: z.boolean().optional(), duration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) })
